definitions.explanation: A disease of the tissues surrounding the teeth, including the gums and bone. Caused by plaque buildup and can lead to tooth loss if untreated.

examples.japanese: {歯周病|ししゅうびょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{予防|よぼう}する→予防する：17341_yobousuru⟧。
{歯周病|ししゅうびょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{歯|は}→歯：00778_ha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{失|うしな}う→失う：01887_ushinau⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧だ。
examples.english: Periodontal disease is a major cause of tooth loss.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{丁寧|ていねい}→丁寧：00896_teinei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{歯|は}→歯：00778_ha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{磨|みが}いて→磨く：02427_migaku⟧、{歯周病|ししゅうびょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防|ふせ}ぎましょう→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧。
examples.english: Let's prevent gum disease by brushing our teeth carefully every day.

notes:
Compound of {歯|し} (tooth) + {周|しゅう} (around) + {病|びょう} (disease). A common medical term appearing regularly on toothpaste commercials and dental clinic signs.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {歯周病|ししゅうびょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{予防|よぼう}する→予防する：17341_yobousuru⟧: to prevent gum disease
- {歯周病|ししゅうびょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧: to develop gum disease
- {歯周病|ししゅうびょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{治療|ちりょう}→治療：03503_chiryou⟧: treatment for gum disease
- {歯周病|ししゅうびょう}⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧: anti-gum-disease measures

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{虫歯|むしば}→虫歯：00299_mushiba⟧: cavity, tooth decay — separate dental problem; often paired with {歯周病|ししゅうびょう} in advertising
- {歯肉炎|しにくえん}: gingivitis — milder form, only the gums; one stage of {歯周病|ししゅうびょう}
